summary.one_liner: Graylog is a free, open log management platform, released under the Server Side Public License (SSPL) v1.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly points elsewhere: it describes Graylog as a free and open log management platform and links to a project website and a documentation site. It names no specific features, installation steps, or supported log sources. It explains how to report bugs or suggest improvements through the issue tracker and how to contribute via a contributors guide. It also lists community chat channels (IRC on freenode and libera, plus community discussion forums). Details on capabilities must come from the external documentation, which the README does not summarize.
stack: Java (inferred from repository name is not stated; no languages named in README)
